svg.title: A few flights do most of the damage
svg.desc: About 2% of flights caused 80% of contrail warming in a 2020 study by Teoh and colleagues; diverting 1.7% of flights by about 2,000 feet cut contrail forcing by 59% for under 0.1% extra fuel. Globally, the North Atlantic carried 4.9% of flight distance but caused 11% of contrail warming (Teoh and colleagues, 2024).
svg.text: A few flights do most of the damage
Teoh et al. 2020 (Japanese airspace) and Teoh et al. 2024 (global, 2019–2021). Per cent.
North Atlantic: share of flight distance
North Atlantic: share of contrail warming
Moving 1.7% of flights about 2,000 ft cut contrail warming by 59% for under 0.1% extra fuel (modelled, Teoh 2020).
